title: Container type form
purpose: Create a box grid or a new version of one, or change an existing version.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.

Entering a code that already exists adds the next version; earlier versions and their boxes are unchanged. Once any box uses a version its grid is fixed: the grid fields are then not offered on the edit form, so add a new version to change them. The form opened from New version is pre-filled from the earlier version.

items.label: Code
items.description: Create only. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement. An existing code adds a new version.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. Inactive versions stay on existing boxes but cannot be chosen for new boxes.

items.label: Rows, Columns
items.description: Each a whole number from 1 to 100. Grid fields; not offered when a box already uses the version.

items.label: Position labels
items.description: Letter rows with numbered columns (A1), or numbered positions (1, 2, 3 ...).

items.label: Numbering order
items.description: Across rows (row-major) or down columns (column-major), counted from the labelled top-left corner (A1 or 1).

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only. Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Editing needs a reason (up to 2000 characters), which is kept in the history with the values before and after. Creating records the setup without asking for a reason. If the record changed since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay on the page, but check the current values before saving again. A save with nothing changed is refused.
